The following events took place in '''3650 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Rucker]] began his [[Sith training]] at the [[Odacer-Faustin Sith academy|Sith academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Odacer-Faustin]].<ref name="Red Harvest20" />
*The [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] decides to put off reconstruction of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] indefinitely, causing the Order to relocate to Tython.<ref name="Gnost">[[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']]</ref>
*During an illegal incursion into the territory of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the forces of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] encounter a [[Chagrian colony|colony]] of the [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mindor/Legends|Mindor]] and launch an [[Attack on Mindor|attack]] that wipes out the colony.<ref name="Passive Resistance">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Sergeant Rusk|Passive Resistance}}</ref>
*The Order begin construction on their [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|new Jedi Temple]] on Tython.<ref name="Codex Temple">{{TORcite|type=codex|Jedi Temple (Tython)}}</ref>
*[[Marcus Trant]] is promoted to become the new [[Director of Republic Strategic Information Service|Director of]] [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] after he is chosen by the retiring [[Unidentified SIS director|director]].<ref name="TORency">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
*[[Andronikos Revel]] begins his career as a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]].
